elena: Hey everyone :wave: Quick heads-up — all-hands this Thursday 10:00am PT (17:00 UTC). Agenda: 1) Exec update (strategy & hires) 2) Product roadmap highlights (Dedicated + Private focus) 3) New data retention & compliance policy overview 4) Open floor Q&A. Please drop questions below or add to the agenda doc: https://drive.company/all-hands/1845-agenda. We'll record and share the link.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Thu 10:00 PT — All Hands (elena). Calendar invite sent to all. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)

mike: Can we get the slide deck before the meeting? want to prepare a 2-min question.

elena: Yes — will publish slides ~1hr before and the deck after. If it's urgent, paste your Q now.

caroline: Any plan for APAC folks? 10am PT is pretty late here.

elena: Recording + two follow-up office hours (EMEA/APAC friendly). Will post times in this thread after the meeting.

samir: Will the Dedicated pricing updates be announced? need to prep customers.

elena: We'll cover pricing guidelines at a high level during the roadmap segment; detailed pricing docs will be sent to Sales next week — tag me if urgent.

rebecca: Couple of policy questions: retention windows & KMS defaults — can I submit ahead?

elena: Please do. Paste bullets here or add to the agenda doc. We'll prioritize policy Qs in the meeting.

mike: Ack — adding mine now.

elena: (post-meeting) Thanks all — recording: https://videos.company/meeting/1845123456. Top takeaways: 1) Hiring: +20 engineers planned for H2, 2) Dedicated: autoscale + burst beta launching in June, 3) Data policy: default retention 90 days, enterprise opt-in for extended retention with KMS/HSM, 4) Console: per-route cost breakdown landing in May. Follow-ups: slides + pricing doc posted below.

elena: Slides: https://drive.company/all-hands/1845-slides. Internal pricing doc: https://confluence.company/pricing-dedicated.

caroline: Thanks! Appreciate the APAC-friendly office hours — please add me for the 15:00 UTC slot.

samir: Adding notes to the customer prep doc. ping me if you want a read-through.

rebecca: Submitting a short deck of policy Qs to the agenda doc now.

elena: Great — will follow up with owners on action items. Huge thanks to Product & HR for getting the hiring plan out. :tada:
